bullets.text: A youth created a ruckus with a sword on the middle of the road in Sengundram in Thiruvallur, and the office should monitor police action on this viral incident.
Southern Railway awaits RDSO clearance to fix the platform gap at Adambakkam station, and the office should track passenger safety updates.
Pallikaranai Deputy Commissioner Eswaran was transferred among four police officers, and the office should note the administrative change.
Severe traffic congestion occurred on Poonamallee Mount Road ahead of Diwali, and the office should coordinate with traffic authorities for relief.
Avadi and Tambaram police destroyed over 1.7 tonnes of seized ganja along with other narcotics, and the office should appreciate the anti-drug drive.
University of Madras approved an MoU with Sutherland Global Services to set up an AI lab, and the office should support this digital initiative.
LiveX introduced NVIDIA-powered human-like AI hosts for public venues to provide conversational assistance, and the office should watch emerging tech trends.
